deadline.value: Applications close December 8, 2026 at 11:59 pm EST; interviews on Zoom in late January.
deadline.quote: December 8, 2026 - applications and accompanying requirements can be submitted until 11:59 pm EST.

gre_general.value: The Biology Graduate Group does not require or accept GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: The Biology Graduate Group does not require or accept GRE scores.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores of any kind are not accepted.
gre_subject.quote: The Biology Graduate Group does not require or accept GRE scores.

english_waiver.value: TOEFL, IELTS or TSE is required, but one page waives it for colleges where English is the language of instruction while the FAQ says the institution's primary language must be English; confirm with the department for an Indian English-medium degree. No minimum score is set.
english_waiver.quote: International candidates who attend a college or university where English is the language of instruction do not need to submit a language score.

also.quote: Requirement can be waived for candidates who graduate with a Bachelor's degree from an institution whose primary language is English.
Therefore, we do not have a cut-off score for admissions.

supervisor.value: You apply to the graduate group and do lab rotations in year 1, but you are strongly encouraged to contact faculty before applying.
supervisor.quote: We strongly encourage prospective students to contact faculty with whom they may be interested in working, to determine whether the lab is accepting new students

also.quote: Students undertake lab rotations in their first year to gain experience with different research approaches

funding.value: All admitted students are fully funded for at least five years, subject to satisfactory performance (2026-27 stipend $49,000).
funding.quote: Students are fully funded for a minimum of five years dependent upon satisfactory academic performance.

entry_route.value: The pages do not say whether a master's is needed.

notes: The Biology department cannot award fee waivers itself; requests go to the SAS Graduate Division.
